summary: Allow explicit abandonment of proven non-applied failed optimistic intents

replay.detail: Unknown delivery outcomes continue to retry the same idempotency key.

schema.detail: No wire or database schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Shared discardFailed removes only a failed entry after the caller proves non-application. Sending and accepted entries cannot be discarded; authoritative reconciliation remains the only settlement path for accepted actions.

recovery.detail: Interrupted in-flight operations remain recoverable with their original key.
